children: Soluna secures conditional ERCOT Base Load classification for its 100 MW Project Dorothy campus.
ERCOT conditionally classified Project Dorothy’s 100 MW as Base Load in Batch Zero, preserving interconnection capacity.
Classification is conditional pending ERCOT verification; Soluna is participating and expects confirmation.
Soluna submitted an additional 50 MW interconnection request at Dorothy; it is under study by the transmission provider.
With prior conditional Base Load for Project Kati, Soluna now has 266 MW across Texas campuses conditionally classified.
Company reports ~206 MW operating capacity and a development pipeline of ~6.3 GW; Dorothy is built behind the meter at Briscoe Wind Farm.
